title: Sprint V2-6: TUI Stake/Unstake + F5 auto-claim UX
brief: Add Stake (F7) and Unstake (Shift+F7) forms to TUI. Refactor F5: silent auto-claim CLAIM_ALL before opening Burn form. Show hint when staked==0 AND marks==0. Remove MarksModal.

decisions.F5_flow: On F5: submit ClaimTx(CLAIM_ALL) synchronously, wait response, refresh marks, then open BurnForm. If claim fails (no matured / daily limit), open BurnForm with current marks anyway.
decisions.hint: If staked==0 AND marks==0: show infobox 'No marks and no stake — use F7 to stake PWM first' instead of BurnForm.
decisions.F7: Stake form — amount input + current PWM balance header. Enter submits StakeTx. Esc closes.
decisions.ShiftF7: Unstake form — same pattern, shows current staked balance. Try Shift+F7; fallback to F8 if crossterm doesn't deliver Shift+F7 in integration tests.
decisions.MarksModal: Remove marks_modal.rs and all references. F5 claim+burn combined modal is no longer needed.
decisions.wall_clock_guard: Remove 1-hour wall-clock guard from TUI — node enforces FreeClaimDailyLimit natively.
decisions.accrue_marks_note: Per-block accrue_marks (legacy path) and explicit ClaimTx are additive parallel paths — not a V2-6 scope item; document in issues-report.md as architecture note.

acceptance_criteria: F7 opens stake form; submits StakeTx; account staked balance updates in TUI after poll.
Shift+F7 (or F8 fallback) opens unstake form; submits UnstakeTx.
F5: if staked==0 AND marks==0, shows hint infobox (no BurnForm opened).
F5: if marks>0 or staked>0, auto-claims synchronously then opens BurnForm with updated marks.
Help line in TUI footer updated to show F7/Shift+F7.

delegations.prompt_summary: Независимое ревью V2-6: AcctRow.staked, stake_form + F7/Shift+F7, F5 auto-claim + hint, marks_modal removal, tx_submit stake/unstake, fn segments, cargo check/test pwm-tui
delegations.notes: AC выполнены; cargo check --workspace и pwm-tui tests — ok; 0 violations check_rust_fn_name_segments на pwm-tui/src. Нит: F8 fallback из decisions не реализован; F5 ветка в tui_loop длинная.
